title: Roasted Mediterranean Squash Skillet
description: A flavorful and nutritious skillet dish featuring roasted Mediterranean squash.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean squash
ingredients.notes: Any variety of Mediterranean squash, such as acorn or butternut.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra-virgin olive oil.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt or kosher salt.

instructions: Cut the squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds.
Place the squash on a baking sheet, cut side up.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Roast the squash in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Remove the squash from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Scoop the flesh of the squash into the skillet with the garlic.
Toss the squash with the garlic and season with salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
